svg.title: A grid of 362 cells, in rows of 38, ordered by how far each pole's base readings sit above the nearer gate. The frames step through NF4 rounding and 10 random changes of its norm. Each flips 63 to 85 poles, and 26 to 39 of them lie in the first quarter of the grid.
svg.text: On Qwen2.5-0.5B, NF4 and random changes of its size
flip many of the same poles: those near a gate
Each cell is one of Qwen2.5-0.5B's 362 passing poles, nearest a gate first. A filled cell flips:
it passes its test prompts on the base model and fails on the changed one.
Poles run left to right, then down: the nearest to a gate at the top left, the furthest at the bottom.
